notes.title: Important information from the developers
notes.content:
Hello everyone

The development team of the game “Last Wish" is in touch. In the fall of 2023, we released the first 45-minute episode in early access, and in April 2024, the second 1.5-hour episode. The first episode is available in demo mode. 

The game script is designed for 4 episodes. However, the sales results do not allow us to continue development. We will provide user support and are open to communication, but the final release date has been postponed indefinitely.

You can help us finish the novel. We are collecting $23,500, which are needed to release the final episode.

We collect funds through Boosty: 
https://boosty.to/lastwish/single-payment/donation/600687/target?share=target_link

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324829/bdb15845c668b35efb73c39e6b70b77b7e380b8e.png[/img]

Thank you all for your support and feedback. 

With love, "Last Wish" team

notes.title: We published an update, fixed minor bugs
notes.content:
Friends, yesterday we published version 1.1.5 of the game. What is included in the patch? 

- Fixed a bug with the phone button (removed multiple clicks). At the beginning of the second episode, a mysterious stranger endlessly asked some players, "Do you want to go to the zone?" 
- Fixed a bug with loading the game after the scene with the stone in the swamp
- Fixed a bug with multiple repetition of Kris's lines 
- Removed the bug with the launch of the video via a mysterious link from the SMS at the end of the first episode 

Thank you for helping us test the game and showing us the flaws, we try to fix everything promptly. Peace to all!

notes.title: A new cabinet of thoughts: What's the best way?
notes.content:
We have a question for you.
To show the flow of contradictory thoughts that explodes in a person's head at the borderline moments of life, we came up with the idea of visualizing them in the form of a tag cloud.

[previewyoutube=1GR9tzjbnqI;full][/previewyoutube]

In the first episode, according to the idea of the gem designer, some thoughts “run away” from the cursor, and when you catch the right one, it is voiced aloud and starts the narrative further. The next version of this mechanic has been released in the update: now thoughts can be caught and “burst" with the cursor.

Attention, a question. What's the best way?

notes.title: Premiere of the Russian crime detective "Last Wish"
notes.content:
Premiere of the Russian crime detective "The Last Wish". The game is released in early access and consists of 4 episodes. The total gameplay time will be 2-2.5 hours.

The main character of the game, Kristina, is a young girl who decided to become independent, works part-time in a webcam to spite her parents and dropped out of university. A teen drama turns into a detective story when all of Kristina's wishes begin to come true, and in the most cruel and dark way. In the new episode, she will have to overcome difficulties and negotiate with different people to clear herself of suspicion of murder.

[previewyoutube=FGDIzf8SE6w;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What will be included in the update from April 25, 2024?[/b]

Thanks to everyone who left feedback and shared feedback with us! We share the results of our work for six months. We not only made a new episode for 1.5 hours of gameplay, but also slightly improved the first episode.

- For example, in the first episode we improved the animations. There is still a lot of work to do, but we have improved the initial result and we are not going to stop there.
- We re-recorded several scenes where the emotions of the voice actors were unreliable.
- Removed unnecessary loading screens, now they appear only when switching important scenes.
- The mechanics of variation have been changed: if earlier it was necessary to choose verbatim answers, now the choice must be made between different reactions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324829/bdc3d2632ebc8935dcb97924db96006040e11c06.png[/img]

Some of the player's decisions can now lead to a tragic ending for the main character. In general, according to the script for the final episode, we plan to make several completely different endings of the story, some of which may seem very unexpected.

We came up with and drew new characters and environments. We have an e-girl with a difficult character, a loser blogger trying to look cool, parents who worry about their children who have grown up so quickly, a police investigator, a skuf, a Udmurt grandmother, as well as hooligans in an atmospheric dark entrance. And we haven't told you about the homeless Vasily yet.

[b]Added new game mechanics [/b]

In the first episode, according to the idea of the game designer, some thoughts “run away” from the cursor, and when you catch the right one, it is voiced aloud and starts the narrative further. After the release, an update of this mechanics will be released: now thoughts can be caught and “burst” with the cursor.
[previewyoutube=0jEy5iculVU;full][/previewyoutube]
A few more simple game mechanics will be added that will not let you get bored: for example, the player will have to balance on a slippery log, and also select the code for the intercom. And of course, the topic will remain and develop with the ability to read correspondence on the phone and view publications on social networks.
[b]
New characters and timelines[/b]
In the second episode, several timelines are added in which players will get to know new characters. Instead of “drunk cattle” Nikita (we took this wonderful formulation from the first reviews of the game, and we liked it so much that we took it into the script of the second episode), an athlete, a Komsomol member and handsome Mark Belsky appears, with whom Chris may have something (or maybe not - she's such a variation).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324829/f4f37dd0766fc87baee1966789eff909a382d28c.png[/img]

However, Mark is not as simple as it seems (but this is from the third episode, which we are already writing).

On April 25, evaluate everything for yourself! And we will be looking forward to your feedback and impressions.

notes.title: Locations of the second episode: the entrance of Nick's parents
notes.content:
We are working hard on the second episode: we have drawn all the locations, we are actively collecting scenes. We plan to release the second episode at the end of April.

Well, today we will show one of the locations of the second episode – the entrance of Nick's parents
White-green walls, dim flickering light and an old painted elevator are all in the tradition of entrances from residential areas. But this is not just a typical entrance.

This is one of the most important locations of the second episode. According to the plot of the game, tough and even violent events will take place there. And also, Kris will get to know Nick's parents, and learn things about his life that she didn't even know about before.
[previewyoutube=WInuM_Jv4wA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devblog: how are the preparations for the release of episode 2 going
notes.content:
While everyone was celebrating and then moving away from the holidays, our team did not sit idly by. We will tell you what happened to us.

The second part is much more difficult than the first, both technically and logically. We expect that the technical release of the second episode will take place in mid-March, but there may be slight shifts. It all depends on the testing stage and the presence of errors.

In the meantime, we are working tirelessly.

The script of the second episode was finally approved. The gameplay of episode 2 is about an hour and a half, many new characters have appeared in it, and the action will take place not only in our days, but also in the past.

We started the voice acting: the script was read by the roles. For some characters, the voiceover has already been recorded and is waiting for the assembled scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324829/7e627f1756205baf21bcbfb42154e13d0c72edb6.jpg[/img]

Models of all the characters were ready at the end of last year, and this year we made models of cars, residential buildings and public institutions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324829/ebfffb204e4e5d218cc41e3fa153a6cb6bfdfd21.jpg[/img]

As for realism, our designer recently completed the entrance and apartment of Nick's parents, and his attention to detail will really make you believe in the reality of what is happening. There are homemade knitted doormats and the burnt buttons in the elevator. The broom tiles on the floor and the inscriptions on the entrance walls are not forgotten – a mandatory attribute of a typical Russian house in a rough neighborhood, where Nick comes from. The location turned out to be very cool. Enjoy:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324829/881f468a90825da22e4ab38a3a226a1b0041c471.jpg[/img]

The assembly of the scenes is in full swing and very soon we will be able to show the first teasers. Follow the news!

notes.title: Results of the year
notes.content:
In March 2023, we started developing our first PC game, Last Wish. In September, we published the first 45 minutes of gameplay in early access.
In 2 months, we will release the second episode of Last Wish. We tell you what has already been done:
The script is completely ready, it is designed for 1.5 hours of gameplay. The game will feature new characters, as well as additional locations, there will be much more variability and new mechanics. By the way, the action will take place not only in modern times.
All the characters are drawn, and most of the environment is ready. Some characters are already familiar to us, and some will appear for the first time.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324829/f0241dd95ecb907cf2109068186835c1719651f2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324829/9746d401afbf7e8a9afcb14947c190982167f9b9.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324829/482cb18f243594f5c5aaa92811be8d36def0f6d0.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324829/d80a61391e1243a70f599286ea12a0c456188573.jpg[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324829/eefcd246085d065bd75786070d51630126f69f2d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324829/7f05f11b715f5389e0157c76ccacdf68c94d5a03.png[/img][/url]
In the time remaining before the release, we plan to work out the environment, assemble all the scenes, set up transitions between branches and implement all the mechanics that we came up with.
Thanks to everyone who supported our team by purchasing the game in early access, and separately to those who shared feedback with us and published reviews and reviews. We are very grateful to our players. Every review, even negative ones, inspires us to make the game better and more interesting.
Congratulations on the upcoming holiday!

notes.title: Release schedule of new episodes
notes.content:
We are often asked: when will the next episode be released? 

We answer: we are working on the second episode right now. Its release is scheduled for February 2024. In it, you will find a continuation of the story, an investigation, and of course, new characters. 

There will be 4 episodes in total in the novella. There is a lot of work ahead, we are serious and we are not going to slow down. We look forward to your support and feedback!

notes.title: Update from September 28
notes.content:
Good afternoon, dear players. We are continuing to work on the game and have prepared several changes that are included in the new version:
- added emotions to the characters, now they better reflect their attitude to what is happening
- now Chris has several clothing options, she changes clothes depending on where she is going
- achievements have appeared in the game, you will have to try to get them. 

We hope this will make the game even more interesting.

notes.title: Stream with developer
notes.content: We want to introduce you to the features of the game, as well as the possibilities that the game can offer us.

notes.title: Early access
notes.content:
The visual novel "The Last Wish" was released in early access. Let's figure out what this means?

Early access is a unique opportunity for players to influence the development of the game. Those who bought early access become part of the development team, helping them shape the gameplay, leaving their feedback and suggestions. This is a great opportunity to feel the atmosphere of creativity and contribute to the improvement of the game.

At the same time, those who buy the game in early access get it forever: all new episodes and updates are already included in the price.

We are very grateful to everyone who leaves their comments and gives us feedback 🤝 Together we will make the "Last Wish" even more exciting and cooler!

notes.title: Hello and welcome!
notes.content:
We started working on the project in early 2023 and are now ready to introduce you to the heroes of our history, the world of the game and the developers. 

The first episode is already available. Download, play, share reviews. And we will talk about everything that happens in the studio and behind the scenes. 

We will be glad to every subscriber, your opinion is important to us. So feel free to discuss and criticize. 

"Last Wish" is in early access. This means that we are developing the second episode of the game and at the same time improving the first one. Constantly monitoring our social networks and collecting feedback from players to make the novel even better and work out every little thing. 

Thank you for being with us. Have a nice game.
